question: In which of the following months India-Maldives Joint Statement was released during the Official Visit of the President of the Maldives to India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**August 2022**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India and Maldives released a Joint Statement during the Official Visit of Maldivian President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to India in **August 2022**.
 
• The visit aimed to strengthen bilateral ties between India and Maldives and enhance strategic cooperation.
 
• During the visit, both nations signed multiple agreements in areas such as defense, trade, health, and infrastructure development.
 
• Key discussions included counter-terrorism, maritime security, and maintaining regional peace in the Indian Ocean.
 
• The Joint Statement emphasized mutual respect for sovereignty, trust, and enhanced collaboration in regional and global platforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India-Maldives Relations:**

 
 
• India is one of Maldives' closest allies and partners, providing economic assistance, disaster relief, and defense cooperation.
 
• Both nations share cultural and historical ties, which have strengthened diplomatic relations over the years.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Indian Ocean:**
 
 
• The Indian Ocean is a critical region for global trade and maritime security.
 
• Both India and Maldives play a key role in maintaining peace and stability in this region.
 
 
 
• **Maldives' Strategic Importance:**
 
 
• Maldives is situated at a vital maritime route, making it strategically important for India’s security and trade.
 
• India’s "Neighborhood First" policy prioritizes strong ties with Maldives.
 
 
 
• **Defense Cooperation:**
 
 
• India has provided military assistance to Maldives, including the supply of patrol vessels and training programs.
 
• Joint military exercises like "Ekuverin" are conducted to enhance defense collaboration.
